podcast_summary: Conversations with global hospitality leaders focused on leadership, revenue management, commercial strategy, and career development.

host.name: Shannon Knapp
host.bio: Shannon Knapp was a hotel industry veteran with over 26 years of experience in reservations, revenue optimisation, and distribution management. She was an active member of the HSMAI Asia Pacific Advisory Board, a certified HSMAI trainer in revenue, distribution, and reservations, and the founder of SKnapp Consulting. She created Hotelier Huddle as her homage to the hotel industry.

sources.claim: Shannon Knapp, CHIA, 26-year veteran, founder of SKnapp Consulting, HSMAI Advisory Board member
sources.quoted_snippet: Shannon Knapp founded SKnapp Consulting in January 2015 to provide strategic support to small-to-medium hotel groups and independent properties across APAC.

sources.claim: Host and producer of Hotelier Huddle podcast, tribute after her passing in 2026
sources.quoted_snippet: This episode is released in memory of Shannon Knapp, our host and dear friend. Hotelier Huddle was Shannon's homage to the hotel industry and the people within it who meant the world to her.

production_team.role: Producer and Audio Editor for Hotelier Huddle

production_team.role_curator: Audio transcription lead, open-source repository architect, and MCP server host

homage.dedication: This repository is an homage to the legacy of Shannon Knapp, CHIA. Until her last breath, Shannon was passionate about advancing the hotel profession alongside her best friends in the industry, the colleagues and leaders she interviewed across these 20 episodes. Following her passing, her friends and collaborators brought this archive together so her work would endure: Heidi Egger engineered the audio and produced the recordings, and David Haberlah transcribed the corpus, built the open-source repository and hosts the Model Context Protocol server. This archive preserves Shannon's contribution so her legacy continues to support future generations of hoteliers.
